'''Keres II''', alternatively known as '''Keres Two''', was a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] [[Stone/Legends|rock]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The planet was located in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core's]] [[Koros sector/Legends|Koros sector]]. By [[3643 BBY]], a [[Keres II mining outpost|mining outpost]] was set up to [[Mining/Legends|harvest]] [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] deposits, though it was abruptly abandoned. 

==Description==
Keres II,<ref name="Byss" /> also known as Keres Two,<ref name="TCM" /> was a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] [[Stone/Legends|rock]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core's]]<ref name="Byss" /> [[Koros sector/Legends|Koros sector]].<ref name="NOP" /> It was the ninth planet that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Koros]]<ref name="ByssCorr" /> and had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="Byss" /> Keres II, along with the rest of its system, was located along the [[Byss Run/Legends|Byss Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], connecting the planet to the [[Keeara Major system/Legends|Keeara Major system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was also located along [[Koros-Tython hyperlane|another hyperlane]], which existed between around [[17,000 BBY]] and around [[11,000 BBY]] and connected the planet to the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]].<ref name="Warfare" /> The planet contained [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] deposits.<ref name="TCM" />

==History==
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Carbonite Mines" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission, which occurs after the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] fled Keres II, must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a [[Keres II mining outpost|mining outpost]] was set up to [[Mining/Legends|harvest]] the planet's carbonite deposits. However, the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] working at the outpost suddenly abandoned the planet without explanation.<ref name="TCM" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around 3643 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two opposing factions in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to Keres II. The companion ventured deep into the [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and encountered a [[Keres II terentatek|terentatek]]<ref name="TCM" />&mdash;a [[Terentatek/Legends|creature]] related to the tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] known as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], who were in turn associated with the Empress Teta [[Star system/Legends|system]] via a history of conquest and [[Politics/Legends|political]] rule<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;there that had been freed from an icy prison. The companion escaped the planet with a haul of carbonite and various [[Ore/Legends|ores]].<ref name="TCM" />
{{EndGame}}

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]<ref name="Nexus">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>&mdash;the Empress Teta system's fourth planet<ref name="Byss" />&mdash;featured nine [[Gold/Legends|golden]] spires in the [[Royal District/Legends|Royal District]] of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|planetwide city]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]]. The spires represented each planet in the Empress Teta system, including Keres II, and were located along the equator in such a way that Koros hit the spires in the order of their planet's orbit.<ref name="Nexus" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keres II was first mentioned in the second installment of ''[[Byss and the Deep Core]]'', a series of supplements written by [[Rodney Thompson]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and released on the [[Wizards.com]] on [[April 14]], [[2005]].<ref name="Byss" /> It was later identified as "Keres Two" in a Scavenging Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The mission was initially only available to Galactic Republic&ndash;aligned players,<ref name="TCM" /> though both this restriction and the information about the mission's outcome were removed as part of the 4.1 update on [[February 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="4.1Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/282016/game-update-4.1-anarchy-paradise-patch-notes|text=Game Update 4.1: Anarchy in Paradise Patch Notes|date=2016-02-08}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Empress Teta system, and therefore Keres II, in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
